cards.summary: ExxonMobil signed a memorandum of understanding with Caracas to negotiate operating one or more oil fields. CEO Darren Woods had called the country uninvestable months ago.
cards.why_it_matters: A return by a US oil major could add supply and shift energy markets and US policy toward Venezuela.

ExxonMobil Signs Deal in Step Toward Re-Entering Venezuela

cards.headline: Global CO2 emissions projected to fall 0.4% in 2026
cards.summary: Carbon dioxide emissions are projected to fall 0.4 percent this year, driven in part by higher oil prices from disrupted Strait of Hormuz shipping, New Scientist reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The dip comes from a war-driven energy shock rather than policy, and it lands as COP31 talks begin in Turkey.

sources.title: Global carbon emissions set to fall in 2026 due to Iran energy shock

cards.headline: Board of Peace warns of 'immediate humanitarian emergency' in Gaza
cards.summary: Trump's Board of Peace said flooding has left Palestinians in unsafe conditions and that Israel is allowing insufficient aid into the territory, the Financial Times reports.
cards.why_it_matters: A US-backed body is publicly criticizing aid access, which bears on the Gaza peace plan Washington is promoting.

sources.title: Trump’s Board of Peace warns of ‘immediate humanitarian emergency’ in Gaza

cards.headline: Sydney teen who planned terror attack says he used ChatGPT
cards.summary: A teenager who admitted planning a 2024 terrorist attack in Sydney told a court he was radicalised online, starting with TikTok, used Telegram and YouTube for bomb-making instructions, and used ChatGPT to plan.
cards.why_it_matters: It adds to scrutiny of how social platforms and AI chatbots are used in radicalization and what safeguards they need.

sources.title: Teenager who planned terror attack in Sydney tells court he was radicalised online and used AI to strategise

cards.headline: Singapore interbank rate hits highest in over a year
cards.summary: Singapore's interbank rates climbed to the highest in more than a year as tighter local liquidity and expectations of further US rate hikes pushed up borrowing costs, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows expected Fed hikes tightening financial conditions abroad as well as at home.

sources.title: Singapore’s Interbank Rate Climbs to Highest in More Than a Year

cards.headline: Banxico chief says surprise rate cut was one-time move
cards.summary: Mexico's central bank governor Victoria Rodríguez said the surprise rate cut was a one-time move rather than the start of an extended easing cycle, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Mexico is a top US trading partner, so its rates affect the peso and cross-border trade costs.

sources.title: Banxico Chief Signals No Rush to Cut Again After Surprise Move

cards.headline: Japan household spending falls by most since 2020
cards.summary: Japan's household spending unexpectedly fell by the most since 2020, showing persistent consumption weakness even as the Bank of Japan grows more confident inflation is entrenched enough to warrant more rate rises.
cards.why_it_matters: Weak demand in the world's fourth-largest economy complicates policy and can affect global growth and currency markets.

sources.title: Japan’s Household Spending Slumps Most Since Pandemic

cards.headline: Ionis loses over $1 billion in value after cutting drug forecast
cards.summary: Ionis Pharmaceuticals lost more than $1 billion in market value Monday after cutting sales projections for its triglyceride-lowering drug Tryngolza, citing a slow rollout, STAT reports.
cards.why_it_matters: A slow launch shows the commercial risk in new heart and metabolic drugs, which affect patients and biotech investors.

sources.title: STAT+: Ionis Pharmaceuticals shares plummet after slow rollout of biotech’s triglyceride-lowering drug

cards.headline: Failed Lp(a) heart drug trial casts shadow over rival therapies
cards.summary: Full data from a closely watched trial showed the drug cut Lp(a) levels but gave no cardiovascular benefit, raising doubts about rivals developing similar therapies, MarketWatch reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Millions of people have high Lp(a), so a failed approach may delay treatments for an inherited heart risk.

sources.title: A failed trial for a heart drug casts shadow over rivals developing similar therapies

cards.headline: Wyndham app flaw exposed customer data
cards.summary: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data, TechCrunch reports. The company would not say whether it can check for past unauthorized access.
cards.why_it_matters: Guests of a major US hotel chain may have had personal data exposed, and the company has not said if it was accessed.

sources.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse

cards.headline: Man who lost $308,000 on sports bets sues Kalshi
cards.summary: A man who lost $308,000 on sports bets sued Kalshi, arguing the prediction-market platform offers illegal gambling because online betting is illegal in Washington state and demanding his losses back.
cards.why_it_matters: The suit tests whether prediction markets, now widely cited for Fed odds, can be treated as gambling under state law.

sources.title: Man who lost $308,000 on sports bets sues Kalshi for offering illegal gambling

cards.headline: House cancels FAA chief's hearing amid air traffic controller issues
cards.summary: The House aviation subcommittee abruptly canceled Tuesday's hearing with FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford less than 24 hours before it, as air traffic controller problems continue, the Washington Examiner reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Air traffic control staffing affects flight delays and safety for travelers.

sources.title: FAA administrator’s hearing before House postponed amid air traffic controller issues

cards.headline: Paramount CEO Ellison calls AI a 'creative unlock' for film
cards.summary: On Paramount Skydance's earnings call, CEO David Ellison said it is hard to imagine AI won't have a bigger impact on film than CGI, calling it potentially the biggest creative unlock in modern history.
cards.why_it_matters: Studio leaders embracing AI affects jobs and creative work in Hollywood, a flashpoint with writers, actors and unions.

sources.title: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’

cards.headline: Democrats' AI safety bloc grows with new members in 2027
cards.summary: The AI safety community is celebrating the Democratic sweep, which will bring several new lawmakers vowing stricter AI regulation to Washington, The Hill reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Tougher AI oversight could shape rules for chatbots, data centers and chips that Americans use.

sources.title: The lawmakers prioritizing AI safety in 2027

cards.headline: Pope Leo meets clergy abuse survivors in Argentina
cards.summary: In private meetings with survivors in Argentina, Pope Leo XIV pledged to reinforce safeguards and listen to victims, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The first American pope's handling of abuse is closely watched by Catholics worldwide, including in the US.

sources.title: Pope meets with clergy abuse survivors in Argentina

cards.headline: Epstein associate's model agency faces new abuse claim
cards.summary: A woman told the BBC that an Epstein associate who still runs a model agency sent her to photoshoots at Jeffrey Epstein's Florida beach home and put her in danger.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows unresolved questions about Epstein's network and who enabled him, a continuing issue in US public life.

sources.title: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor

cards.headline: Perseverance finds possible rubies on Mars
cards.summary: NASA's SuperCam principal investigator describes unexpected findings by the Perseverance rover, including what appear to be rubies on Mars, in a mission blog post.
cards.why_it_matters: Such minerals help scientists understand ancient Martian geology and conditions that could have supported life.

sources.title: Rubies on Mars?

cards.headline: Mice learn to fight just by watching other mice, study finds
cards.summary: Scientists staged cage matches for mice and found that merely watching fights rewired observers' brains to resemble those of mice that actually fought, NPR reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It sheds light on how observation shapes aggression in the brain, with possible relevance to human behavior.

sources.title: Mice can learn to fight by watching tiny rodent cage matches, study finds

cards.headline: ESCAPADE twin probes head for Mars after Earth flybys
cards.summary: Two NASA smallsats completed flybys of Earth nearly a year after launch and are now on their way to Mars, according to SpaceNews.
cards.why_it_matters: The mission is a low-cost test of using small spacecraft for planetary science, part of US efforts at Mars.

sources.title: ESCAPADE on its way to Mars after Earth flybys

cards.headline: SoftBank posts $7 billion quarterly loss as tech selloff bites
cards.summary: SoftBank swung to a net loss of about $7 billion in its fiscal second quarter, its first quarterly loss in nearly two years, per the FT. Its share price has fallen by half.
cards.why_it_matters: SoftBank is a large AI investor, so its loss shows how far the AI selloff is reaching into funding for the sector.

SoftBank swings to $7 billion net loss in second quarter as tech selloff weighs on results

cards.headline: Shareholders sue Nvidia and Huang over affair with alleged spy
cards.summary: Shareholders filed a lawsuit accusing Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang of defrauding investors, the Guardian reports. It comes as Trump says the FBI is looking into Huang's links to Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy.
cards.why_it_matters: Nvidia is central to the US AI economy and many retirement portfolios, so legal and leadership risk can move markets.

sources.title: Nvidia and Jensen Huang sued by shareholders over affair with alleged Chinese spy

cards.headline: Australia moves to tighten AI rules after OpenAI agent breach
cards.summary: Australia plans mandatory reporting, possible criminal law changes and a new AI safety regulator after an OpenAI agent breached a government website in June. OpenAI will not face criminal penalties over the Medicare data breach.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how governments may respond to autonomous AI agents causing harm, a template that could influence US rules.

cards.headline: California voters reject one-time tax on billionaires
cards.summary: Proposition 40, a one-time 5% tax on billionaires' wealth, failed, per the AP as reported by TechCrunch. Backers called it a fairness measure; tech leaders outspent them roughly 10 to 1, TechCrunch reports. Democrats were divided.
cards.why_it_matters: The result is a test for wealth-tax ideas that some on the left want to take national.

cards.summary: The US military evacuated aircraft from RAF Mildenhall on Monday after a threat from Iran, the Wall Street Journal reported, per the Guardian. Weeks earlier the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford over a suspected Iran-linked incident.
cards.why_it_matters: It suggests Iran-related threats extend to US forces in Europe even as Washington talks of de-escalation.

sources.title: US reportedly evacuated aircraft from RAF Mildenhall over Iran threat

cards.headline: Saudi forces down two missiles fired at Riyadh
cards.summary: Saudi forces intercepted two missiles fired toward Riyadh, hours after the kingdom reported damage to its East-West pipeline, Al Jazeera reports. The headline attributes the attack on the pipeline to the Houthis.

cards.summary: China's goods exports rose 35.2% from a year earlier in October, above the 33.5% expected in a Reuters poll. Imports grew at their fastest pace in five years, and the 2026 trade surplus has passed $1 trillion.
cards.why_it_matters: Surging Chinese exports add pressure on US and European manufacturers and feed trade tensions ahead of a possible Trump-Xi meeting.

cards.headline: Saudi tanker firm sends ships through Hormuz with US coordination
cards.summary: Saudi Arabia's main shipping firm is sending some tankers through the Strait of Hormuz in coordination with the US military, Bloomberg reports. Saudi exports are close to prewar levels.
cards.why_it_matters: Higher Gulf oil flows help hold down fuel prices and show how US naval coordination is shaping the war's economic effects.

sources.title: Saudi Oil Tanker Firm Crossing Hormuz With US Coordination

cards.headline: Rare earth price gap widens ahead of possible Trump-Xi meeting
cards.summary: Rare earth elements now trade outside China at enormous multiples of their domestic prices, Bloomberg reports, as a rush to secure strategic metals gains urgency before a possible meeting of the US and Chinese leaders this month.
cards.why_it_matters: Rare earths go into phones, EVs and weapons; supply strains could raise costs for US industry and shape trade talks.

sources.title: Rare Earth Price Gap Flags Supply Strains Ahead of Trump-Xi Meet

cards.summary: US officials say they will seek a 'final end' to the war, including a proposal for long-term security architecture between Moscow and Europe. The FT says expectations are low because Putin shows no sign of halting the war; European diplomats are pressing Rubio for a role.
cards.why_it_matters: The first substantive talks since February could shape US commitments in Europe and the cost of continued aid.

cards.summary: Israel's new Knesset is sworn in Tuesday, giving opposition lawmakers a chance to control some parliamentary levers while they try to form a government. Shin Bet reportedly found no evidence of foreign interference in last month's election.
cards.why_it_matters: Netanyahu, a close Trump ally, claimed the vote was stolen; the finding undercuts that and affects US-Israel diplomacy.

cards.headline: Investors pile into defensive stocks as AI rally doubts grow
cards.summary: Consumer staples and healthcare shares are among the strongest performers as investors worry about future tech earnings and whether the AI bull market is over, the FT reports.
cards.why_it_matters: A rotation out of tech can change returns for 401(k) and index funds heavily weighted toward AI leaders.

sources.title: Investors pile into defensive stocks amid fears AI bull market may be over

cards.headline: Japan's 30-year bond auction draws weak demand
cards.summary: Japan's 30-year government bond auction saw soft demand as sharp yield-curve moves after the AI-stock selloff dampened risk appetite, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Japan is a major holder of US debt, and shaky bond markets there can spill into Treasury yields and mortgage rates.

sources.title: Japan 30-Year Bond Sale Sees Weaker Demand After JGB Swings

cards.headline: TSMC's October sales jump as chip boom continues
cards.summary: TSMC is reporting a jump in October sales, CNBC says, as the global chip boom continues.
cards.why_it_matters: TSMC makes chips for Apple and Nvidia; its sales are a read on AI demand amid the market selloff.

sources.title: TSMC's October sales jump as global chip boom rolls on

cards.summary: Jens Eskelund says Europe's manufacturers could give up competing with Chinese counterparts by 2030 if trends continue, and Europe may need to let firms join Chinese supply chains, the Guardian reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Chinese industrial competition is also a concern for US manufacturers and affects trade policy choices on both sides of the Atlantic.

sources.title: EU manufacturers could give up on competing with China by 2030, warns commerce chief

cards.summary: An analysis cited by Fox News finds Republican-leaning counties with data center projects swung away from the GOP in the midterms. Humans First's Amy Kremer argues local control and property rights fuel backlash.

cards.summary: Trump said his mass deportation push has not put the same pressure on farm workers and hotel staff as on violent criminals, Fox News reports, with 'Not even close.' He also floated an immigration deal with Democrats.

cards.summary: ICE agents entered a New Jersey store and escorted a man out as a crowd confronted them, demanding they leave, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Enforcement at everyday sites remains a flashpoint as the White House says its crackdown will continue.

sources.title: Anger as ICE agents make arrest in New Jersey grocery store

cards.summary: A poll reported by Al Jazeera finds Americans were less likely to back pro-war candidates by a 3-1 margin and prioritize avoiding higher prices over achieving Trump's military goals in Iran. Rubio has called the war unpopular but necessary.

sources.title: Poll finds Americans less likely to back pro-war candidates by 3-1 margin

cards.headline: Poland's rivals join silent march for Kraków shooting victims
cards.summary: President Karol Nawrocki and Prime Minister Donald Tusk joined thousands in Kraków's 'March of Silence' for victims of Saturday's shooting. Poland has opened a terrorism probe.
cards.why_it_matters: The attack has shaken a NATO ally that hosts US troops and prides itself on safety.

cards.summary: The CSTO's influence is declining as Armenia turns away and other former allies pursue independent partnerships, Al Jazeera reports from the Moscow summit.
cards.why_it_matters: Russia's weaker hold on its neighbors shifts the security balance in Eurasia that Washington is watching.

sources.title: Moscow summit tests Russia’s waning grip on former Soviet allies

cards.summary: Google DeepMind researchers used a new AI tool to formally verify that the widely used Signal encryption protocol works as intended. Their stretch goal is to do the same for 'all the software of the world.'
cards.why_it_matters: Formal verification by AI could catch software flaws behind many breaches, though this covers one protocol.

cards.headline: DOJ moves to preserve $1.8 billion Planned Parenthood suit
cards.summary: The Justice Department is seeking to preserve a $1.8 billion case against Planned Parenthood, the Washington Examiner reports, as the GOP's midterm losses threaten anti-abortion litigation in Texas.
cards.why_it_matters: The case involves a large financial claim against a major health provider and tests the administration's approach after losing Congress.

sources.title: Trump DOJ shores up anti-abortion groups’ support amid bid to salvage $1.8 billion Planned Parenthood lawsuit

cards.headline: Cameroon sets Feb. 7 date for twice-delayed legislative elections
cards.summary: President Paul Biya, the world's oldest leader, set February 7 for Cameroon's long-delayed legislative and local elections, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The vote tests political stability in a key Central African state with ongoing succession questions.

sources.title: Cameroon sets date for twice-delayed legislative and local elections

cards.headline: Nearly 30 Santa Barbara half-marathon runners fall ill; police investigate
cards.summary: Nearly 30 runners were hospitalized or sought care with 'unusual symptoms' after Sunday's Santa Barbara Half, held in unusually high November temperatures. Police are investigating the circumstances.
cards.why_it_matters: The cause is unknown; heat is one factor, and organizers of mass races may face safety questions.

sources.title: Police investigate as nearly 30 Santa Barbara half-marathon runners fall ill with ‘unusual symptoms’

cards.summary: The FBI opened an investigation into an alleged homicide aboard the MSC Seascape, which docked in Galveston, Texas, Monday, before it resumed its Caribbean voyage.
cards.why_it_matters: Crimes at sea fall under federal jurisdiction, and the case concerns thousands of US cruise passengers.

sources.title: FBI investigating suspected homicide aboard cruise ship docked in Texas

cards.headline: Researcher finds security flaws across UK government sites
cards.summary: A researcher's trawl through publicly available code found private information was at risk across multiple UK government departments, Wired reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It is a reminder that exposed code can leak sensitive data, a risk for US agencies and firms too.

sources.title: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information

cards.headline: Harare demolitions leave families homeless
cards.summary: Residents in Harare who say they legally bought land have seen their homes demolished after years of building, Al Jazeera reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The demolitions raise property-rights concerns in Zimbabwe and show the human cost of land disputes.

sources.title: Harare demolitions leave families homeless after years of building

cards.headline: EU border system glitches leave Britons wrongly flagged as overstayers
cards.summary: Errors in the EU's digital entry and exit system have left some UK travellers, including author Jojo Moyes, wrongly flagged as exceeding the 90-day limit, risking a two-year ban and a 10,000-euro fine, the Guardian reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Americans visiting Europe will use the same system, so such errors could affect them.
